item.title: The brave new war machine
item.description: How a clique of unhinged techno-optimists is putting humanity at risk.

item.title: US-Israel strikes on Iranian oil depots trigger environmental disaster and historic oil shock
item.description: Bombing of energy infrastructure in Tehran sparks toxic rainfall warnings, record crude price surge, and accusations of war crimes as fires and smoke engulf Iran’s capital.

item.title: Despite twisted hype about “so much winning,” America staggers, the self-inflicted, breakthrough icon of losing
item.description: The only yellow brick road towards more affluence for the under-trained or geographically-limited is to match skills with today’s employment demands or pull up stakes and move to less benighted areas.

item.title: Trump’s Iran war costs $1 billion a day while hospitals close and healthcare disappears
item.description: Critics warn the administration’s military campaign could fund food aid and healthcare for millions of Americans already struggling with rising prices.
